The illustration features a stylized portrait of a man from the chest up against a vibrant red background. The man has short black hair, thin eyebrows, a mustache, and wears rectangular-framed glasses. He is dressed in a light-colored, long-sleeved button-down shirt. His body is angled slightly to the right, and he is rolling up his right sleeve with his left hand, which is clenched into a fist.

Large, bold black text on the left reads "TIGA SKENARIO KALLA". Above this, the top of the image shows the masthead of a publication, "TEMPO," in large white letters partially obscured by the man's head. Below the masthead, smaller white text reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Other text at the top includes "IRWANDI YUSUF: DARI PENJARA KE PENJARA" on the left and "BAWANG PUTIH JALUR ILEGAL" on the right. In the bottom left corner, a barcode is accompanied by vertical text: "9 770126 427302", "9-15 JULI 2018", and "RP 45.000". Small, less clear vertical text is also present near the barcode.
